items.source: Uses of EncoderHttpMessageWriter in org.springframework.http.codec.protobuf
HttpMessageWriter that can write a protobuf Message and adds X-Protobuf-Schema, X-Protobuf-Message headers and a delimited=true parameter is added to the content type if a flux is serialized.
items.translation: 能够写入 protobuf `Message` 的 `HttpMessageWriter`，并在序列化流时添加 `X-Protobuf-Schema`、`X-Protobuf-Message` 标头以及内容类型中的 `delimited=true` 参数。

items.source: Provides an encoder and a decoder for Google Protocol Buffers.
items.translation: 提供用于 Google Protocol Buffers 的编码器和解码器。
